maddeler.e:
ننبطح (form VII)
# نَنْبَطِحُ (nanbaṭiḥu) /nan.ba.tˤi.ħu/: first-person plural non-past active indicative of اِنْبَطَحَ (inbaṭaḥa)
# نَنْبَطِحَ (nanbaṭiḥa) /nan.ba.tˤi.ħa/: first-person plural non-past active subjunctive of اِنْبَطَحَ (inbaṭaḥa)
# نَنْبَطِحْ (nanbaṭiḥ) /nan.ba.tˤiħ/: first-person plural non-past active jussive of اِنْبَطَحَ (inbaṭaḥa)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
